Parked 2026-10-11 at Dave's request ("Park it too"); needs his go-ahead to file.

pinned.title: Monetization: tip-jar feature tiers + Guardian enforcement
pinned.detail: Dave's idea (2026-10-11): limited factory settings (basic, just enough to start adding buddies), tip jar unlocks expanded functionality; per-machine/per-user feature control; Guardian agent to weigh in on anti-circumvention architecture. Astro's take given in thread: only server-side features truly paywallable (hosting, sync, drill automation, artifact builds); signed entitlements + server-delivered feature modules + Guardian as nudging enforcer. Open question: want Guardian to draft the full architecture as a brief?
